welcome.public_title: ## Welcome to BAD — Barcelona AI & Data Systems
welcome.public_body:
Read the community rules, then press **I accept the rules** to get the member role and unlock the community.

Be respectful, inclusive and constructive. English is the primary community language. Share practical experience and technical depth — no hype, aggressive sales or recruitment spam. Do not share confidential information or personal data. Give credit when sharing others' work. No harassment, hate speech or unsolicited DMs. Use the right channel and avoid repeated cross-posting. Moderators may remove content that harms the community.

After you are a member, use `/introduce` in introductions and `/roles` for cosmetic interests.
